newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar slumps, ends at 488.75/489.75/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar slumps, ends at 488.75/489.75/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar slumped in brisk trade to 488.75/489.75 per dollar as the Central Bank sat back from the session and strong dollar demand from the interbank market weakened the exchange rate, traders said.
The bolivar closed Friday at 487.75/488.75 per dollar.
"There's a huge amount of liquidity at the moment ...but you have do something with the bolivars so investors were switching into dollars," said one trader.
"Demand was very strong ... mostly from the interbank market," he added.

Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between the Central Bank supplying liquidity and intervening. Lately, the Bank has slowed its sale of dollars into the market.
